relations: Harriot（叙述者/日记）；Celia（被写对象）；Calahan（被毒者）；Beatrice（附身者）；野猪
numbers: 12/20/84 日记日期；三周老十岁；1983-04 起投毒

facts.fact: 又下雪；钟楼六点；「冬天坚硬，而我在融化」
带走《Dreams of the Rose》一半是恶意；看你 frantic misery 是 validation——直到你带毒液追来
若必须像 Ethan Frome 滑下山也要离开兽与你
facts.anchor: sled down the mountain like Ethan Frome
facts.verbatim: sled down the mountain like Ethan Frome

facts.fact: 砷：很慢、他要的、只放进他叫我煮的咖啡；他病数周却不离工作、日复一日回办公室/福克纳/也回我
facts.anchor: I only put it in the coffee he asked me to make
facts.verbatim: I only put it in the coffee he asked me to make

facts.fact: 起初像恶作剧（一点胃痛）；「若他停止贬低我，大概会康复」
他要求沉默在场；她实验语调音高姿态想造对话——除了点头一切被当打断；「我是他大脑的投影幕」
facts.anchor: I was a projector screen for his brain
facts.verbatim: I was a projector screen for his brain

facts.fact: 他越来越常叫她、确信为那几剂；他渴望、眼变亮、她几乎不睡
facts.anchor: I became certain it was for those little doses
facts.verbatim: I became certain it was for those little doses

facts.fact: 最后一次：她在咖啡上方徘徊、说不清是否决定；倒进杯、搅、他接过——「我的论文答辩就此没发生」
她以迷宫包围记忆（中心是毒，如 Beatrice）；你是树篱、The Rose、学院、课程、论文修订
facts.anchor: I’d built a labyrinth around the memory
facts.verbatim: I’d built a labyrinth around the memory

facts.fact: 感恩节后警察来，她辞职、把车与东西藏你屋；学院以为她早走了
她本该当医生/儿童图书馆员/牙科卫生员——「若有别的路，我很久前错过出口」
facts.anchor: I’d missed the turnoff a long time ago
facts.verbatim: I’d missed the turnoff a long time ago

facts.fact: 野猪立车前、侧腹起伏如地狱风箱；她下车、伸手、按风的音高吹哨——兽走向她、闭眼
facts.anchor: heaving like the bellows of hell
facts.verbatim: heaving like the bellows of hell

facts.fact: 她举左轮对准咽喉、开枪；猪瘫进雪堆、红流汇进山的静脉；她哭、浸在「无词的语言」、看见 Ely 与 Body——「我知道真正的结局」
facts.anchor: I know how Dreams of the Rose was meant to end.
facts.verbatim: I know how Dreams of the Rose was meant to end.

facts.fact: 她把日记留在车里不再需要——「既然我知道真正的结局应该是什么」
facts.anchor: Now that I know what the true ending must be.
facts.verbatim: Now that I know what the true ending must be.
